title: cystopteris montana
intro: Cystopteris montana, commonly known as the Montane bladder fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris montana include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
